description: White text on a light green button fails 4.5:1 contrast.

issue.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
issue.html: <button type="button" style="background: rgb(143, 209, 143); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 16px;">Add to cart</button>
issue.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.79 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #8fd18f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
